issue.title: Committing vault edits with /sase_git_commit (as ~/bob/AGENTS.md instructs) leaks SASE plan archives into ~/bob/sdd/plans/

task_type_fields.impact: Any agent that edits the vault adds non-note files, without the required parent frontmatter, to Bryan's synced vault. Bryan's Obsidian graph and search fill with agent plan documents.
task_type_fields.location: ~/bob/AGENTS.md commit instruction; SASE plan-archive step of /sase_git_commit (sase stitch create) when run from ~/bob
task_type_fields.repro:
`~/bob/AGENTS.md` tells agents to commit vault edits with `/sase_git_commit`. Phases bob-cli-gr.1 (W43) and bob-cli-gr.2 (W42) did that from `~/bob`, and each commit added that phase's tale-plan archive to the vault: `ec8ae84c5` and `7d84dcb46` ("docs(periods): draft 2026-W4x review") created `sdd/plans/202611/w43_weekly_review.md` and `w42_weekly_review.md`. Vault sync then updated both (`326abcfb4`, `cd2e540c1`). In W42, sync had already committed the actual note (`ead3ef9d8`), so the manual commit held only the plan archive. The canonical copies live in the bob-cli--plans repo (`202611/w4x_weekly_review.md`). The vault copies were stale duplicates without the `parent` frontmatter the vault requires. The bob-cli-gr land agent deleted them (vault-sync commit `6fb387ad5`).

Probable mechanism, unconfirmed: `~/bob` contains a legacy, gitignored `sdd/beads/` store from June 2026, so SASE may resolve `~/bob/sdd/plans` as the plans dir when it commits from the vault. Decide where to fix it: make SASE never archive plans into a repo that isn't the plan's home; have the vault ignore `sdd/plans/`; and/or have `~/bob/AGENTS.md` defer to vault auto-sync, which committed 15 of the 17 Review notes within seconds.

issue.creation_reason: Following ~/bob/AGENTS.md, the bob-cli-gr W43 and W42 phase agents committed SASE plan archives into Bryan's vault, which the epic goal forbade (proposed by bob-cli-gr.2 notes #2 and #3). The land agent removed the stray files, but any future agent editing the vault the same way will leak them again.
